name: Chase overdue invoices from Google Sheets with escalating Gmail drafts

No guilt trips, no threats. Do not include any links; a payment link is added separately. Output only the email body.

parameters.content:
## Invoice Chaser (Jupi Labs)
Every morning at 9am this finds overdue, unpaid invoices in your Google Sheet and writes a reminder into Gmail **as a draft**. Nothing is sent until you open the draft and hit send.

**Tone escalates by days overdue:**
- 1-14 days: polite first nudge
- 15-30 days: firmer second reminder
- 31+ days: final notice, with the invoice's payment link added (if the sheet has one)

Skips invoices marked PAID, not yet due, or chased in the last 3 days. Logs the chase time back to the sheet.

## Setup (5 min)
1. In **Read invoices** and **Log the chase**, pick your invoices spreadsheet (tab `Invoices`).
2. Connect credentials: Google Sheets, Gmail, OpenAI.
3. Columns on the `Invoices` tab: Invoice #, Client, Client email, Due, Amount, Status, Payment link, Last chased.
4. Mark paid invoices with Status = PAID.

Swap the OpenAI node for any chat model if you prefer.
